name: Marione soundboard keys
description: Play your Marione soundboard sounds with keyboard shortcuts from any tab, and with global keys even when the browser is in the background.

sound-1.description: Play your sound 1 (Ctrl+1 on the page). Set the scope to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts to use it with the browser in the background.

sound-2.description: Play your sound 2 (Ctrl+2 on the page). Set the scope to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts to use it with the browser in the background.

sound-3.description: Play your sound 3 (Ctrl+3 on the page). Set the scope to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts to use it with the browser in the background.

sound-4.description: Play your sound 4 (Ctrl+4 on the page). Set the scope to Global in chrome://extensions/shortcuts to use it with the browser in the background.
